meta.title: JamBox — Independent app studio
meta.description: JamBox is an independent app studio in Seoul. We make software for the moments people gather — to play, to learn, and to belong.
meta.ogDescription: Independent app studio in Seoul. Makers of Boardhood and more.

hero.title: Software for the table we gather around.
hero.body: JamBox makes small, carefully packed apps for play, learning, and the rituals in between. We started with board games. We are building toward everything that brings people into the same room.

home.nowBody: A home for board game groups. Find a table, log the match, keep the collection, and stay close to the people you play with.
home.pillarPlayBody: Games are how strangers become a table. Boardhood treats matchmaking, records, and community as one craft.
home.pillarLearnBody: The same care belongs in study. We are building tools that make language practice feel like a session you want to return to.
home.pillarBelongBody: Every JamBox app should make it easier to show up — for a game night, a study streak, or the next thing we ship.
home.studioBody: Jam as in a session of making something together. Box as in a product small enough to hold. JamBox is the studio that ships those boxes from Seoul.
home.ctaBody: Support, press, and App Store questions all reach the same desk.

appsPage.title: Apps from JamBox
appsPage.body: We ship a few things, slowly, and we stand behind them. Live products sit beside work still on the table.
appsPage.boardhoodSummary: Find players, host rooms, track matches, and keep your collection — a board game community in one app.
appsPage.sharelogSummary: A private trail of every link you share — to yourself and to others. Saved on this device.
appsPage.labSummary: Practice that feels like a gathering, not a grind. A companion for people who learn a language the way they keep a hobby — together, on a rhythm.

boardhood.title: Boardhood
boardhood.lede: Discover board game communities, meet players, and keep every match organized in one place.
boardhood.featureCommunityBody: Share match moments, react and comment, and stay connected through profiles and posts.
boardhood.featureMatchBody: Create or join rooms by date, location, or game. Find a nearby table or an online lobby.
boardhood.featureRecordsBody: Submit results, review history, follow your stats, and curate the games you own.
boardhood.supportBody: Boardhood is designed and operated by JamBox. Privacy, terms, and help live on this site so they stay with the studio — not a parked page.

sharelog.title: Sharelog
sharelog.lede: A private log of every link you share — to yourself and to others. One tap from Instagram, X, TikTok, or any app, saved on this device.
sharelog.featureTrailBody: Shares land in one feed: All, To me, and To others. Add notes, memos, and categories, then search when you need them again.
sharelog.featurePrivateBody: Sharelog is local-first. The share itself never waits on a network. Previews may load in the background from the original page.
sharelog.featureExportBody: Take your trail with you as a JSON file, or merge one back in. Deleting the app removes what was stored on that device.
sharelog.supportBody: Sharelog is designed by JamBox. Privacy for this app is posted here so Google Play, Apple, and anyone you share the listing with can read the same words.

about.title: About JamBox
about.lede: JamBox is an independent app studio based in Seoul, Republic of Korea. We design and operate consumer apps, beginning with Boardhood, and we will keep making products for play, learning, and belonging.
about.storyBody: The name is a jam session packed into a box: a small team making something you can actually hold. We care about analog rituals — a game on the table, a language practiced out loud — and we translate them into software that still feels human.
about.orgBody: This website is the public home of JamBox. The legal name, headquarters address, and contact below are the same details we use for our applications and developer accounts.

support.title: Support
support.lede: If something in a JamBox app is broken, confusing, or needs a human, write to us. We read every message.
support.emailBody: Include the app name, your device, and a short description of what happened. For account or privacy requests, say so in the subject line.
support.boardhoodBody: Match rooms, collections, sign-in, and notifications are handled from the same inbox. We also publish privacy and terms for Boardhood on this site.
support.sharelogBody: Sharelog keeps your trail on the device. For that app, write to info@jambox.site. The Sharelog privacy policy is on this site.
support.responseBody: We are a small studio. We aim to reply within a few business days. We do not ask for passwords, and we will never require you to install software to receive help.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: JamBox is based in Gangseo-gu, Seoul. Reach us by email for support, partnerships, and developer-account matters.
contact.legalNote: Please use this address for official correspondence related to JamBox and its applications.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how JamBox (“JamBox”, “we”, “us”) collects, uses, and shares information when you use jambox.site and our applications, including Boardhood and Sharelog. It is written for people, not only for lawyers. Sharelog has an additional, app-specific policy at https://jambox.site/apps/sharelog/privacy.
privacy.s1Body: JamBox is an independent app studio. Registered address: 90, Magokjungang 8-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea. Contact: jaminthebox1226@gmail.com.
privacy.s2Body: jambox.site is a public organization website. We do not require an account to read it. Standard server logs (such as IP address, browser type, and pages requested) may be processed by our hosting provider to operate, secure, and understand traffic to the site. We do not sell website visitor data.
privacy.s3Body: When you download and use a JamBox application, we may collect information such as your device’s IP address, pages or screens you visit, time spent, operating system, and — where you choose to create an account — identifiers you provide such as email and user ID. Boardhood also uses device location to power nearby rooms, maps, and related recommendations. Sharelog does not use an account or cloud backup: links, notes, and categories stay on your device, as explained at https://jambox.site/apps/sharelog/privacy. We do not use our apps to knowingly solicit data from children under 13.
privacy.s4Body: We use information to provide the product you asked for, to keep accounts secure, to send service notices, to understand aggregated usage so we can improve the apps, and to respond when you contact us. Location in Boardhood is used for geolocation features, anonymized analytics, and, at times, transmission of anonymized location data to service providers who help us operate the app.
privacy.s5Body: Our applications may use third-party infrastructure that has its own privacy policies, including Google Play Services, Google Analytics for Firebase, and Firebase Crashlytics. We may disclose information when required by law, to protect safety or rights, or to trusted processors who may only use the data to provide services to JamBox.
privacy.s6Body: We keep account data while you use the app and for a reasonable period afterward. To request deletion of information you provided, email jaminthebox1226@gmail.com. You can also stop further collection from an app by uninstalling it.
privacy.s7Body: JamBox apps are not directed at children under 13. If we learn that a child under 13 has provided personal information, we will delete it. Parents or guardians may contact us at the email above.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this policy. The current version will always be posted at jambox.site/privacy. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised policy.
privacy.s9Body: Privacy questions: jaminthebox1226@gmail.com. Postal: JamBox, 90, Magokjungang 8-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea.

sharelogPrivacy.title: Sharelog Privacy Policy
sharelogPrivacy.intro: This policy explains how Sharelog, a JamBox app, stores information. Sharelog is local-first: your trail stays on your device unless you export it yourself.
sharelogPrivacy.s1Body: Sharelog is operated by JamBox. Registered address: 90, Magokjungang 8-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea. Sharelog support: info@jambox.site.
sharelogPrivacy.s2Body: Sharelog keeps a private log of links and posts you choose to share to it. Saving a share is meant to be instant. Sharelog writes it first, then may load a preview in the background.
sharelogPrivacy.s3Body: Your trail (links, titles, notes, categories, read state, destination, and photos you save) and your settings (theme, language, defaults) are stored on this device. JamBox does not operate a Sharelog account, sign-in, or cloud backup.
sharelogPrivacy.s4Body: When you save a link, Sharelog may request a preview — title, description, or image — from that page or from public preview services used by that site. Preview images may be cached on the device. Opening the original or using Share sends you to that site or to the system share sheet. jambox.site is a separate website and may process standard server logs as described in the studio privacy policy.
sharelogPrivacy.s5Body: Sharelog does not sell your data, does not show ads in the app, and does not use your trail for cross-app tracking. It does not require an account.
sharelogPrivacy.s6Body: Sharelog is not directed at children under 13, or the equivalent minimum age in your country.
sharelogPrivacy.s7Body: You can delete individual shares or delete all shares from Settings. Uninstalling Sharelog removes data stored on that device.
sharelogPrivacy.s8Body: We may update this policy. The current version is posted at https://jambox.site/apps/sharelog/privacy. The date above is the latest revision.
sharelogPrivacy.s9Body: Questions: info@jambox.site. Postal: JamBox, 90, Magokjungang 8-ro, Gangseo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
